question: What are the three perspectives taken into account by Customer Experience (CX) Journey Research?
reference_answer: CX Journey Research takes into account the Customer Lens, the GitLab Teams perspective, and the Customer + GitLab Intersection.
title: Customer Experience Journey Research

question: Who ensures PDF versions of board meeting materials are securely stored in NBV and Google Drive?
reference_answer: The CLO (Chief Legal Officer) ensures that PDF versions of the materials, including presentations, exhibits, approved Minutes, and Administrative materials, are securely stored in NBV and on Google Drive, labeled with the date of the meeting.
title: Board of Directors and Corporate Governance

question: According to GitLab's Directness value, what should feedback focus on?
reference_answer: Feedback should always be about a person's work, not about the person themselves.
title: GitLab Values

question: Who conducts the technical interview for the Support Engineer hiring process at GitLab?
reference_answer: The technical interview for the Support Engineer role is conducted by Support Engineers, and it is a practical interview covering customer scenarios and other topical areas relevant to the position.
title: Support Hiring

question: What naming convention should Support team members use for their Zoom display name?
reference_answer: They should include their sub-department using the smallest unit they belong to, biasing for customer understanding over technical correctness (e.g. using 'Support Engineering' rather than the full 'Customer Support -> Support Engineering' path).
title: Support Team Handbook

question: What is required before using the Gemini API for custom applications or integrations at GitLab?
reference_answer: Using the Gemini API requires prior Legal/CorpSec review and API-key approval before use; keys should not be self-provisioned, and only Orange data (not Red data) may be sent through custom integrations.
title: AI tool selection

question: According to GitLab's meeting framework, should large meetings like Assembly include presentations?
reference_answer: Yes — for meetings with many participants such as Assembly or other large team meetings, presentations are part of the recommended framework.
title: GitLab Communication

question: What are the four tabs in the Notes feature of the Zuora Collect module?
reference_answer: The four tabs are Users, Groups, Export, and Settings.
title: Zuora Collect module

question: What is one example of a potential extenuating circumstance listed in GitLab's People Policies?
reference_answer: Examples include regional internet or telecommunications outages, natural disasters or severe weather events, sudden medical emergencies affecting the team member or immediate family, civil unrest or political instability, technology failures with no alternative communication, sudden travel emergencies with no connectivity, or unexpected legal detention or immigration issues.
title: People Policies

question: What is the difference between a 'collaborator' and an 'audience' in GitLab's Concept Release Discipline?
reference_answer: A collaborator is someone inside the work, contributing to something still being formed, while an audience is someone being introduced to something ready to be seen. Release phases apply to audiences, whereas collaborators join the dark phase alongside the concept team.
title: Concept Release Discipline

question: What is the process for sending an e-card to celebrate a team member at GitLab?
reference_answer: Create an e-card (e.g. using Google Docs/Slides), upload it to DocuSign, assign signatures to the individuals who should sign, and send the signing request. Once everyone has signed, download the document from DocuSign and Slack or email the card to the recipient. Recommended sites include Ella Cards and Kudoboard Cards.
title: New Hires, Celebrations and Significant Life Events

question: In GitLab's talent assessment, what weight is given to performance against GitLab Competencies?
reference_answer: Performance against GitLab Competencies should be weighted at 40%.
title: Talent Assessment

question: What types of partners are encouraged to consider GitLab's Professional Services Partner (PSP) Program?
reference_answer: Open and Select Partners with existing services practices in areas such as DevOps/DevSecOps, app modernization, digital transformation, Container & Kubernetes, Google Cloud (especially those with the Application Development – Services Specialization), or AWS (especially those with AWS Migration and Modernization, DevOps, or Generative AI Competencies).
title: GitLab Channel Program Guide

question: What is the difference between the Subscription Contact and the Billing Contact in the GitLab Customer Portal?
reference_answer: The Subscription Contact is the primary contact for the billing account, while the Billing Contact receives all invoices and subscription event notifications.
title: GitLab Quick Start for New GitLab.com Customers

question: What should NOT be submitted through GitLab's DAP customer feedback framework as a feature request?
reference_answer: Bug reports or issues where existing features don't work correctly should not be submitted as feature requests — those should go through Support Channels instead. Sensitive information such as customer identifiable information, API keys, or highly confidential details should also be avoided, since submissions become visible GitLab Issues.
title: DAP Customer Feedback Framework

question: During Week 10 of the CSM Internship Program, which stage of the DevSecOps lifecycle is reviewed in depth?
reference_answer: The Configure stage of the DevSecOps lifecycle is reviewed in depth during Week 10.
title: CSM Internship Program

question: During the technical call in GitLab's acquisition process, is access to proprietary code requested?
reference_answer: No — access to proprietary code is not asked for at the technical call stage; code review takes place later, during the confirmatory due diligence phase.
title: Acquisition Process

question: What are Product Security's (PSD) guiding principles at GitLab?
reference_answer: PSD's guiding principles are Business Enablement, Empathy and Accessibility, Pragmatism Over Perfection, and Design for Rapid Iteration.
title: Product Security

question: How often must third party penetration testing be performed, according to GitLab's vulnerability management guidance?
reference_answer: Third party penetration testing must be performed annually.
title: Vulnerability Management

question: What can accompany a management response addressing a TPRM exception at GitLab?
reference_answer: A management response addressing a Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) exception may be accompanied by re-testing performed by the external auditor to validate that remediation was successful.
title: Security Third Party Risk Management

question: According to GitLab's TeamOps tips, who does TeamOps empower?
reference_answer: TeamOps is for both individual contributors and people managers — it empowers individual contributors to be better stewards of their own time and attention, and empowers people managers to lead with deeper conviction while creating more space for their direct reports to grow, develop, and contribute.
title: TeamOps - Redefining Teamwork for the Modern Era

question: How soon after an all-remote meeting should the recording be uploaded?
reference_answer: The recording should be uploaded, with its link and password added to the agenda, within 12 hours after the meeting, to allow for asynchronous consumption by people in different time zones.
title: All-Remote Meetings

question: According to GitLab's live doc meeting practices, what is one benefit of using an agenda doc?
reference_answer: One benefit is that it prevents knowledge leaks, since meetings without agendas are only useful to those present and outcomes are likely to be forgotten over time. Other benefits include a more inclusive meeting atmosphere, a lasting takeaway, and shifting the memorization burden away from humans.
title: GitLab Meeting Best Practices: Live Doc Meetings

question: Who is the Executive Sponsor of GitLab's Customer Use Case Adoption working group?
reference_answer: David DeSanto, the Chief Product Officer, is the Executive Sponsor.
title: Customer Use Case Adoption

question: What happens when a manager approves a nomination through GitLab's Nominator bot?
reference_answer: When a manager approves, the bot automatically takes care of the next steps, sending the nomination to the second level manager and the People Operations team.
title: Incentives at GitLab

question: What is the maximum limit for E1/P1 engineering-driven initiatives per 20 engineers, unless approved by the VP of Product and/or Engineering?
reference_answer: Unless approved by the respective VP of Product and/or Engineering, there is a maximum limit of 1 x (P1 or E1) and 2 x (P2 or E2) per 20 engineers, with a minimum of 1 x P2 per key investment area.
title: R&D Interlock

question: What is the minimum employment duration required to request temporary part-time (Brückenteilzeit) at GitLab GmbH in Germany?
reference_answer: An employment relationship of at least 6 months is required, and GitLab GmbH must employ more than 45 team members (a threshold that is already met).
title: GitLab GmbH (Germany) information & benefits

question: What special feature does the Alfred app's clipboard history have related to 1Password?
reference_answer: Alfred's clipboard history feature is nicely integrated with tools like 1Password and will forget passwords copied from 1Password after they have been pasted.
title: Other apps

question: Roughly how many pages does the printed GitLab team handbook consist of?
reference_answer: Printed, the GitLab team handbook consists of over 2,000 pages of text.
title: The Handbook

question: What is required before deactivating an organization field in Zendesk, according to GitLab's process?
reference_answer: A corresponding request issue (Feature Request, Administrative, Bug, etc.) must exist before deactivating an organization field; if one does not exist, it should first be created and go through the standard process.
title: Organization fields

question: When should you use Glean's Chat feature instead of Search?
reference_answer: Use Chat when you want a synthesized answer, such as 'How do I request a new internal SaaS license?' or 'Where is the process for internal hiring?' — Search is for when you already know roughly what you're looking for.
title: Glean End User Guide

question: What are the three types of Alliance Partners in GitLab's Alliance Partner Program?
reference_answer: The three types are Cloud Partners, Platform Partners, and Technology Partners.
title: GitLab Alliances Handbook

question: What notice applies to victims of domestic and sexual violence in Missouri, according to GitLab's labor and employment notices?
reference_answer: Missouri has a 'Notice to Victims of Domestic and Sexual Violence - Leave Time Allowed' notice listed.
title: Labor and Employment Notices

question: What is the minimum tenure required to transition from SDR to SDR Team Lead at GitLab?
reference_answer: 8 months (including ramp) is the minimum tenure, along with 100% cumulative quota over the last 5 fully-ramped months, willingness to coach, endorsement from SDR management, and a 6-month minimum commitment to the Team Lead role.
title: Sales Development

question: When are Dashboard Folders useful in Gainsight administration?
reference_answer: Dashboard Folders are useful when a Gainsight instance is very large and there are many different user profiles (such as TAM, Onboarding, CSM, etc.); unused dashboards or folders should be removed since there's rarely a strong reason to keep deprecated ones.
title: Gainsight Administration

question: How often are individual performance assessments conducted within GitLab's Channel Sales team?
reference_answer: Individual performance assessments are conducted on a semi-annual basis (mid-year review and end-of-year review).
title: Channel Sales Manager Operating Rhythm

question: How many visibility levels does GitLab provide for each project, and what are they?
reference_answer: GitLab has three different visibility levels for each project: Public, Internal, and Private.
title: FAQ from prospects

question: What scaling configuration is GitLab.com's Postgres database currently running, according to the Scalability page?
reference_answer: GitLab.com is currently running at [1,1,0] — the database is composed of N fully replicated instances (a primary RW with several RO secondaries), each containing a duplicate of the entire dataset.
title: Scalability

question: In the Artifact Registry ADR 021 authorization decision, what happens if a row's evaluation fails?
reference_answer: A failed row evaluation fails the whole request instead of dropping out silently; a row's verdicts come from that row's own evaluation.
title: Artifact Registry ADR 021: Authorization

question: What merge request review approach does the Switchboard team use, and why?
reference_answer: The Switchboard team uses an 'Approve and Merge' approach because the team is currently small.
title: Switchboard team

question: Why is a direct GraphQL query for a Merge Request considered a 'bad example' in the Cells GraphQL design document?
reference_answer: Because Merge Request is not routable, so querying mergeRequest(id: ...) directly is a bad example — unlike querying project(fullPath: ...), which is routable.
title: Cells: GraphQL

question: What should you do if you need database assistance but no stable counterpart is listed for your area?
reference_answer: You should feel free to reach out directly to the #g_database Slack channel.
title: Database Group Stable Counterparts

question: Within how many months of release will newer (N+1) Kubernetes releases be supported by GitLab?
reference_answer: Newer (N+1) Kubernetes releases will be supported within 3 months of their release.
title: Distribution Team Kubernetes and OpenShift release support policy

question: According to GitLab's coaching guidance, what should you do during a virtual coaching session to stay present?
reference_answer: Close out other programs during the session, focus on the other person without judgment, make gestures like nodding to show presence, empty your mind of preoccupations, and ground yourself in an open, curious, and appreciative mindset.
title: Coaching

question: What is the starter template for publishing Claude prototypes to GitLab Pages, and what type of prototypes is it set up for?
reference_answer: The starter template is at gitlab.com/diegocapetown/claude-pages-template, and it is set up for React-based prototypes, since that's what Claude generates by default.
title: Publishing Claude prototypes to GitLab Pages

question: In the Fulfillment Guide's Licenses section, what information does clicking the license details icon show?
reference_answer: It shows the license's type (Cloud, offline cloud, or legacy), whether it's a trial, name, company, email, issued/starts/expires dates, user count, Zuora subscription name and link, and GitLab plan.
title: Fulfillment Guide

question: According to GitLab's Handbook Usage guidance, what type of content should be avoided?
reference_answer: Unstructured content based on formats like Learning Playbooks, FAQs, lists of links, resource pages, glossaries, courses, videos, tests, processes, standard operating procedures, training, or how-to's should be avoided, since these are hard to keep up-to-date and incompatible with organizing by function and result.
title: GitLab Handbook Usage

question: What must be established for a Trusted Data solution before development, according to GitLab's Trusted Data Solution Criteria?
reference_answer: The business problem must be defined with clear revenue impact established, and a Data project Epic must be created to manage development, among other criteria like defining scope and creating a Dashboard Wireframe.
title: Data Development

question: What are the three primary databases used by GitLab's Data Team Platform?
reference_answer: The three primary databases are raw, prep, and prod. The raw database is where data is first loaded into Snowflake; prep and prod are for data that is ready for analysis or getting there.
title: Data Team Platform

question: What GL Account should be selected for Consulting Fees when submitting a Zip Request at GitLab?
reference_answer: GL Account 6017 Consulting Fees should be selected.
title: Tips for Submitting a Zip Request

question: According to the GitLab Testing Agreement v5, what warranties does GitLab provide for testing features?
reference_answer: GitLab and its licensors disclaim all warranties, express or implied, including implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, title, and non-infringement — testing features are provided on an 'as is' and 'as available' basis.
title: GitLab Testing Agreement v5

question: Why did GitLab create its AI Ethics Principles for Product Development?
reference_answer: GitLab created these principles to guide decision-making as they continue to build AI features into GitLab and to ensure these features properly embody their core CREDIT values, while staying true to their Transparency value by publishing the principles.
title: GitLab AI Ethics Principles for Product Development

question: What confirms that a contract has been reviewed and approved by a GitLab Legal Team Member?
reference_answer: The GitLab Legal stamp confirms that a contract has been reviewed and approved by a Legal Team Member — all contracts must include this stamp to be executed.
title: Procurement Guide: Collaborating with GitLab Legal

question: What should you fill out if you have a request for an E-Group member to speak at an external event?
reference_answer: You should fill out the Executive External Event Brief with the key information and email it to the EBA supporting the Executive with your request.
title: Executive Business Administrators (EBAs)

question: What must be linked as the Success Criteria before manager approval in a Proof of Value (POV)?
reference_answer: The customer-specific POV Plan or evaluation document must be linked, and the plan must contain measurable goals, use cases, evidence, and decision criteria.
title: Proof of Value (POV)

question: What should CEO Shadows prioritize when taking notes during E-Group Weekly Meetings?
reference_answer: CEO Shadows should prioritize capturing accurate takeaways over precise notes if they can't type fast enough to keep up with the fast-paced, back-and-forth conversation.
title: CEO Shadow Program

question: Are GitLab team members required to have the social or comms team review their personal social media posts?
reference_answer: No, the GitLab social team will never require a review or oversight of a team member's own personal social media posts, even when using suggestions from Bambu or another provided tool.
title: Team Member Social Media Advocacy

question: What are the two types of sales plays described in GitLab's Sales Plays handbook page?
reference_answer: The two types are Evergreen sales plays (a repeatable set of proven successful sales tactics) and Focused sales plays (a generated set of steps in coordination with a particular time-bound campaign).
title: Sales Plays

question: What is a possible next career step for a Content Marketing Manager at GitLab?
reference_answer: A Content Marketing Manager can progress to Manager, Content Marketing, and from there to roles like Customer Advocate or Marketing Programs Manager.
title: Marketing Career Development - Career Paths

question: Who is the Operational Program Owner in GitLab's Hyperscaler Campaign issue details?
reference_answer: Francine is listed as the Operational Program Owner.
title: Hyperscaler Campaign

question: What score range corresponds to 'Business Critical Technology - Tier 1' in GitLab's marketing technology tiering system?
reference_answer: A score range of 8-9 corresponds to Business Critical Technology - Tier 1.
title: Marketing Technology Tiering System

question: How is Gated Content (like a White Paper) tracked in Bizible, according to GitLab's Campaigns and Programs page?
reference_answer: Gated Content is tracked as an online channel in Bizible.
title: Campaigns and Programs

question: What does a 'Strong Yes' rating mean when conducting a GitLab interview?
reference_answer: A 'Strong Yes' means the candidate exceeded expectations of the competency (meets requirements and aligns with values), the interviewer has no significant questions, and is confident the candidate would succeed in the role.
title: Conducting a GitLab Interview
